source.timing_rule: target-month context uses only forecasts whose origin_month is the immediately prior completed month

derived_context.rw_anchor: RANDOM_WALK forecast for the target month
derived_context.up_votes: count of the three non-RW expert forecasts strictly above rw_anchor
derived_context.down_votes: count of the three non-RW expert forecasts strictly below rw_anchor
derived_context.consensus_direction: UP if up_votes>=2; DOWN if down_votes>=2; otherwise MIXED
derived_context.dispersion: population standard deviation of all four forecasts divided by their mean

role_lock.use_in_gc_break: strategic anchor/context and diagnostic conditioning only

diagnostic_questions: At objective break origins, is monthly H1 consensus aligned with, opposite to, or mixed relative to the pre-break regime?
How does expert dispersion at break origins compare descriptively with non-break origins?
Does monthly context materially explain episodes that FAST/Emergency detect late, without being promoted to a trigger?
